description.value:
You reach into the currents of the Force to test whether a course of action leads toward fortune or ruin. The GM responds with one of three omens: Peace, for outcomes without serious danger; Danger, for outcomes that are risky but may still be worthwhile; or Ruin, for outcomes that lead certainly to death or disaster. The reading does not account for changes in circumstance, such as further powers cast or companions gained or lost.

If you cast this power more than once before finishing a long rest, each casting after the first carries a cumulative 25 percent chance of returning a false, neutral-seeming result regardless of the true outcome.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 2
